svg.style: fill: none; stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; fill-opacity: 1; stroke-opacity: 1; opacity: 1; fill-rule: nonzero; clip-rule: nonzero; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-miterlimit: 4; stroke-dasharray: none; color: rgb(245, 245, 245);
